profile.summary: YouthBeat is an Oakland nonprofit that provides free digital media training to local youth. Students learn video and media production and can work as paid interns. It runs classes and programs at several Oakland public school sites.

review.notes: YouthBeat is an Oakland media-training nonprofit whose website names MetWest High School and other OUSD sites as program partners, which fits the after-school and classroom contracts. The summary, contact details, EIN and 501(c)(3) status are supported by the youthbeat.org pages and ProPublica; the 2024 ruling year versus 2009 founding is a minor caveat (earlier Media Enterprise Alliance entity) and does not change identity.
